crossRefs.note: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are…
Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you, that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged?…
No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.

people.name: Hebrews
people.line: An ethnic group descended from Abraham.

translations.web: He went out the second day, and behold, two men of the Hebrews were fighting with each other. He said to him who did the wrong, “Why do you strike your fellow?”
translations.bsb: The next day Moses went out and saw two Hebrews fighting. He asked the one in the wrong, “Why are you attacking your companion?”
translations.kjv: And when he went out the second day, behold, two men of the Hebrews strove together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?
translations.asv: And he went out the second day, and, behold, two men of the Hebrews were striving together: and he said to him that did the wrong, Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow?
